title: Buttons and Feature Functionality
summary: This topic centers on whether specific buttons and vehicle functions are available, intuitive, and operating as expected, with many fragments too vague or procedural to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the presence of useful functions and prefer simple one-button-per-function controls.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe removed controls and functions that fail to operate, including auto time zone adjustment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention functions working again, not working, needing setup guidance, or not yet being tested, but often lack enough context to classify sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, limiting confidence in a clear sentiment pattern.
Several examples are brief service-writeup statements or status updates that do not provide enough context to classify sentiment reliably.
The topic includes both usability comments about button layout and operational comments about feature performance, which may mix related but distinct issues.
